calendar_rule: T_start is exactly T_end minus 24 calendar months; no market outcome or forecast result used.

coverage_evidence.note: Availability and timestamp checks only; no predictive outcomes were inspected.

endpoint_definition: Latest forecast-origin bar whose six future 4h spot-Amihud bars are fully observable in the common certified Bybit API data. The last target bar starts 2026-10-07 20:00 UTC and closes 2026-10-08 00:00 UTC; 5m spot kline data are complete through 2026-10-07 23:55 UTC. Both assets have the same observed cutoff.
interval_convention: Inclusive forecast-origin timestamps, period_start_utc grid at 00:00/04:00/08:00/12:00/16:00/20:00 UTC.
required_input_streams: Bybit BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT spot 5m OHLCV/quote turnover
Bybit BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT USDⓈ-M linear perpetual funding history
5m mark and index prices for basis
spot and futures transaction archives for frozen taker imbalance features
target_availability: FutureAmihud24_t uses 4h spot Amihud at t+1,...,t+6; final origin 2026-10-06 20:00 uses bars starting 2026-10-07 00:00 through 20:00, all complete by 2026-10-08 00:00 UTC.
warmup_rule: No transaction archives outside the interval are parsed. Frozen six-interval lags are missing where prior in-window history does not exist; 180-prior-interval robust shocks remain missing until 180 in-window observations are available.
